description: This file defines a Java class 'Square' that represents a 2D square object for rendering in OpenGL ES 2.0 on Android. It includes shader code, buffer setup, and draw methods for rendering the square with specified colors and transformations.

classes.name: Square
classes.description: A class encapsulating the data and methods needed to render a square shape in OpenGL ES 2.0 on Android.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Constructor that initializes buffers, compiles shaders, and links the OpenGL program needed to render the square.

methods.description: Method that executes the OpenGL commands to render the square on screen using the provided Model-View-Projection matrix.
